subject: math
cluster: Understand and apply theorems about circles

items.prompt:
A central angle equals the measure of its:
A) Half-arc
B) Intercepted arc
C) Chord
D) Radius

An inscribed angle is ____ its intercepted arc.
A) Equal to
B) Half
C) Twice
D) A third of

An angle inscribed in a semicircle is:
A) $45°$
B) $60°$
C) $90°$
D) $180°$

An inscribed angle intercepts a $100°$ arc. The angle is:
A) $50°$
B) $100°$
C) $200°$
D) $25°$

A radius to a point of tangency meets the tangent at:
A) $45°$
B) $60°$
C) $90°$
D) $180°$

steps: Radius is perpendicular to the tangent.

items.prompt:
An inscribed angle is $35°$. Its intercepted arc is:
A) $17.5°$
B) $35°$
C) $70°$
D) $90°$

Two inscribed angles subtend the same arc. They are:
A) Supplementary
B) Equal
C) Complementary
D) Right angles

steps: Same arc means equal inscribed angles.

items.prompt:
A central angle and an inscribed angle intercept the same $120°$ arc. Their measures are:
A) Both $120°$
B) Central $120°$, inscribed $60°$
C) Central $60°$, inscribed $120°$
D) Both $60°$
